extracted.intended_audience: journalists and media professionals seeking to contact Salvation Army International Headquarters
extracted.subtask_short: media enquiries to Salvation Army IHQ
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for journalists and media professionals on how and where to direct media enquiries to The Salvation Army International Headquarters, including jurisdictional contacts, office hours, out-of-hours procedure, and social media channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: UK and Ireland media enquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: For UK and Ireland media enquiries please contact The Salvation Army United Kingdom and Ireland Territory. UK and Ireland news centre
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journalists covering UK & Ireland should contact the territorial office/news centre rather than IHQ.

rubrics_metrics.name: Routine media enquiries to IHQ
rubrics_metrics.description: For routine media enquiries, please contact the IHQ Communications team using this form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided IHQ communications form for non-urgent, routine media requests directed to International Headquarters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office hours for IHQ responses
rubrics_metrics.description: Our office hours are 08.30 - 17.00 UK time, Monday to Friday.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect responses during these hours; planning outreach within this window increases likelihood of timely reply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Out-of-hours urgent enquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: Outside of these hours, urgent media enquiries requiring IHQ support should be sent to our out-of-hours mailbox.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the specified out-of-hours mailbox for urgent support outside normal office hours.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of responses (media-only)
rubrics_metrics.description: Only media-related enquiries will be responded to.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-media queries sent to IHQ will not receive a response; ensure your enquiry is media-related before contacting IHQ.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct non-media correspondence to local offices
rubrics_metrics.description: All other correspondence or requests for help to The Salvation Army should be directed to the appropriate national or regional office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For service requests or other non-media matters, use 'Find your local office' to locate the correct national/regional contact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow social media for updates
rubrics_metrics.description: Be sure to follow across social media for the most up to date content across our global network
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official channels listed: https://x.com/SalvArmyIHQ, https://www.facebook.com/SalvationArmyIHQ, https://www.instagram.com/salvationarmyihq/, https://www.youtube.com/user/SAIHQ, https://www.threads.com/@salvationarmyihq
